exclusion_reason: The single monotonic clock layer with QPC, RDTSC, tick, timeGetTime, and vertical-blank derivation is implemented and serves the probe RDTSC, but the Win32 HLE surface that would serve the remaining source to a real guest does not exist yet, and the frozen FIX-002 busy-wait and variable-frame corpus evidence is unavailable while BPTK-002 remains red.
promotion_trigger: Promote when QueryPerformanceCounter, RDTSC, GetTickCount, timeGetTime, and vertical-blank all derive from one monotonic source with the one-millisecond period expectation and clamped delta.
expected_failing_assertion: The timing suite cannot run a real guest busy-wait and vertical-blank workload without Win32 HLE, and the corpus-wide tolerance measurement waits on the frozen BPTK-002 denominator.
active_gate_evidence: A regression check proves guest RDTSC read advance exactly the declared cycle amount from one deterministic monotonic base through the real bptk run surface, and clock check prove one-origin consistency, the one-millisecond tick period, the 32-bit wrap, and the clamped delta.
procedure: Drive each guest time source from a single monotonic base with a one-millisecond period and clamped delta.
Run a busy-wait, a vertical-blank spin, and a variable-frame workload and compare elapsed guest time against the reference.
pass_criterion: Every time source stays consistent with the monotonic base within tolerance.
The guest neither busy-spins at full utilization nor runs at double speed.
